title: Verify product video delivery and playback fix
summary: Confirmed the HTML player-link root cause, valid H.264 delivery and JPEG posters, Chrome playback at two viewport sizes, and passing focused regression checks.

changes.detail: Public product data contains player.cloudinary.com HTML embed URLs for Asics Superblast 2 and Armani Intensely. These were passed directly to video src. Resolve existing links on read and normalize future product writes to video/upload H.264 MP4 delivery.
Cloudinary posters, native controls, inline playback, metadata preload, loading status and retryable errors; preserve gallery navigation and prevent video scrubbing from triggering slide swipes.
Regression coverage for URL resolution, signed/external URL preservation, invalid links, loading/error/retry/poster fallback, and image/video switching.

validation.name: Live media diagnosis and delivery
validation.detail: Both affected stored URLs returned text/html. Resolved video/upload URLs returned video/mp4;codecs=avc1 and posters image/jpeg. Two existing direct Cloudinary videos also returned valid video and posters.

validation.name: Real browser decoding
validation.detail: Chrome rendered the updated ProductVideo markup and decoded both affected videos at widths 1280 and 390; currentTime advanced with nonzero video dimensions, readyState 4 and no media error. Initial local navigation harness was aborted; direct document loading resolved that harness issue. This is isolated component playback, not a complete hydrated storefront or physical-device test.

validation.name: Focused regression tests
validation.detail: 9 video/gallery tests, 9 existing preorder/product API tests and 6 change-history tests passed. Focused lint passed without warnings.

validation.name: Application source TypeScript
validation.detail: TypeScript check scoped to app, components and lib passed using artifacts/product-video-fix/tsconfig.json.

validation.name: Default repository TypeScript
validation.detail: Default tsconfig includes old artifacts/publication-20261017/conflicts snapshots containing merge markers; this prevents the unscoped check. Those unrelated files were not modified.

validation.name: Remaining validation and publication
validation.detail: No physical Android/iPhone or Safari test, full production build, authenticated admin save, or deployment performed. Existing stored records remain intact; render-time normalization supports them and future API saves normalize embed links. History is local until the learning app is rebuilt or served locally.
